Question: Assalmwalikum.Resp/ mufti sahab, I have a problem of dropping of preseminal fluid usually after urination or after bathing.So to overcome this problem i am placing tissue paper after bathing and after an hour i am removing it in order to avoid the falling of drop on my underwear.1]Here is it necessary to clean the private part(after removing the tissue paper.2] Whether iam correct?or if not suggest me. Answer ID: 8416 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2034/1628=H/1429) (1) It is necessary to wash. (2) The way you do is right. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
